text: City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018, adopted this Item as amended, and in so doing, directed the Deputy City Manager, Internal Corporate Services, in conjunction with CreateTO, to enter into discussions with faith-based organizations to explore possibilities to acquire properties that are slated for sale that could include a shelter as well as other related City Services.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Referred the item to the Transition Lead, CreateTO to work with the Deputy City Manager, Internal Corporate Services and report back as necessary.
